english.title: Use vehicle / vehicle combination with elongated cab

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Road Vehicle construction and use regulations 1986

english.standardoffencewording:
*On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a

(A)_[vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE..),]_
(B)_[vehicle combination, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE COMBINATION..),]_

with an elongated cab otherwise than permitted by regulation 96B of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 96B of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

on a road

otherwise than permitted by regulation 96B

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Fixed penalty tickets may be issued for this offence, see Schedule 3 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988; the amount is £50 (section 53 of the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988 and Schedule 1 to the Fixed Penalty Order 2000).
(ii) Where it can be shown that the use of the rear aerodynamic devices has been dangerous, consider breach of regulation 100 of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
